user.title: Connect a local feeder
user.description: Install the Pet Feeder Local firmware overlay first. No Tuya account or local key is needed here.

data_description.address: Use the address shown by the firmware installer, for example http://192.168.1.123:8080.
data_description.token: Copy it from the installer or your private home-assistant-setup.json backup.
data_description.stream_source: Recommended when Home Assistant and Frigate share the camera. Leave empty for a direct connection.

reauth_confirm.title: Update the private API token
reauth_confirm.description: Enter the current token for this feeder. Your existing entities will be preserved.

data_description.address: Use the address shown by the firmware installer, for example http://192.168.1.123:8080.
data_description.token: Copy it from the installer or your private home-assistant-setup.json backup.
data_description.stream_source: Recommended when Home Assistant and Frigate share the camera. Leave empty for a direct connection.

reconfigure.title: Update feeder connection
reconfigure.description: Change the local address, private token or shared camera stream. The device identity must stay the same.

data_description.address: Use the address shown by the firmware installer, for example http://192.168.1.123:8080.
data_description.token: Copy it from the installer or your private home-assistant-setup.json backup.
data_description.stream_source: Recommended when Home Assistant and Frigate share the camera. Leave empty for a direct connection.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the local feeder. Check power, Wi-Fi and its API address.
error.invalid_auth: The feeder rejected this token. Copy the private API token from the installer.
error.invalid_response: The device returned an unsupported local API response. Check the supported firmware version.
error.wrong_device: This address belongs to a different feeder. Enter the address of the original device.

abort.already_configured: This feeder is already configured. Its discovered address has been updated if necessary.
abort.invalid_discovery: Unsupported discovery response. Add the feeder manually.

cannot_connect.message: Cannot reach the local feeder. Check power, Wi-Fi and its API address.

invalid_auth.message: The feeder rejected this token. Copy the private API token from the installer.

invalid_response.message: The device returned an unsupported local API response. Check the supported firmware version.

wrong_device.message: This address belongs to a different feeder. Enter the address of the original device.

entry_not_loaded.message: Select a loaded Pet Feeder Local integration entry.

invalid_schedule.message: Invalid meal table. Use up to eight meals and whole portions from 1 to 10.

invalid_portions.message: Choose a whole number of portions between 1 and 10.

feeding_disabled.message: The feeder MCU is disconnected or manual feeding is disabled. Check the device before serving.

feed_unknown.message: The feeding outcome is unknown. Check the feeder before serving again; this request was not retried.

action_failed.message: The local feeder could not confirm this action. Check connectivity and read the current state before trying again.

schedule_conflict.message: The feeder schedule changed since it was loaded. Reload the editor before saving.

schedule_verification.message: The MCU schedule readback did not match. Reload and inspect the actual saved meals.

invalid_video_request.message: Enter a valid Frigate HTTP origin, camera name, event ID and timezone-aware event timestamp.

stale_video_event.message: The feeding-video event must be within the last ten minutes.

video_queue_full.message: The feeding-video queue is full. Check the Pet Feeder Local persistent notifications before retrying.

mcu_disconnected.title: Feeder MCU is not responding
mcu_disconnected.description: The local camera service cannot communicate reliably with the feeding controller. Check the feeder power and restart this feeder if needed. Do not serve again until connectivity returns. This issue clears automatically after recovery.

set_schedule.name: Set feeding schedule
set_schedule.description: Replace the MCU meal table after a fresh revision check and verify the exact readback. The feeder executes saved meals independently of Home Assistant.

config_entry_id.name: Integration entry
config_entry_id.description: The Pet Feeder Local entry to update.

expected_revision.name: Expected revision
expected_revision.description: Copy the revision attribute from the scheduled meals sensor immediately before editing.

meals.name: Meals
meals.description: Up to eight weekly rows: weekdays (Sunday bit 0), hour, minute, portions and enabled.

queue_feeding_video.name: Queue feeding video
queue_feeding_video.description: Create a silent 25x Frigate video for an observed scheduled feeding, send it to Telegram and clean up its export. Does not dispense food.

detail_cameras.name: Detail cameras
detail_cameras.description: Exactly two Frigate camera names, shown below the overhead view from left to right.

record_detail_cameras.name: Record complete detail-camera windows
record_detail_cameras.description: Request finite event recordings immediately. Requires a 60-second Frigate alert buffer and alert retention mode all.

caption_options.name: Caption choices
caption_options.description: A list of phrases used in shuffled, persisted cycles without repetition.
